selection.ownership: BlazeMeter is a Perforce Software product (Minneapolis, Minnesota, United States). The reviewed edition is the public international API at a.blazemeter.com/api/v4, not a mainland-China product.

research.searchCoverage: Official BlazeMeter API v4 Basic Auth, GET /user credential validation, accounts/workspaces/projects/tests reads, Perforce ownership, and dated incident search reviewed on 2026-09-13. Historical Jenkins plugin CVE-2025-13472 and Perforce Helix Core insecure-defaults research are recorded; not an unresolved BlazeMeter SaaS API-key compromise. This is not a breach-free claim.

Official BlazeMeter Performance API v4 at a.blazemeter.com with Basic Auth and GET /user validation. Dated incident search on 2026-09-13 recorded historical Jenkins plugin CVE-2025-13472 and Perforce Helix Core misconfiguration research.

incidents.subject: CVE-2025-13472 BlazeMeter Jenkins Plugin missing authorization
incidents.finding: Jenkins plugin versions before 4.27 listed credential IDs, workspaces, and project IDs to any Jenkins user.
incidents.limitation: Historical plugin CVE under the 2026-09-13 waiver.

incidents.subject: P4WNED Perforce Helix Core insecure defaults
incidents.finding: Internet-exposed Perforce Helix Core servers with insecure defaults. Parent-company VCS product, not the BlazeMeter SaaS API.
incidents.remediation: Perforce published hardening guidance; not treated as unresolved BlazeMeter API compromise.
incidents.limitation: Historical parent-product research under the 2026-09-13 waiver.

research.waiverAuthority: User waiver dated 2026-09-13 permits historical non-China incident coverage.

adaptations: Credential-only healthcheck maps to documented GET /user, the pinned validation path.
Native omits the upstream user-agent. HTTP 200 envelopes use bodyErrorPaths [error] because success sets error to null.
Optional skip/limit query pagination. sort array query from pinned source is omitted.
accountId is required. Optional enabled and textFilter query params match pinned source; sort is omitted.
workspaceId is required. Optional skip/limit query pagination. sort array query is omitted.
testId is a required encoded path segment. Starting a test is omitted as a write.

healthcheck.title: Healthcheck
healthcheck.description: Validate BlazeMeter API keys with GET /user.

accounts.list.title: List accounts
accounts.list.description: List BlazeMeter accounts available to the API key.

workspaces.list.title: List workspaces
workspaces.list.description: List BlazeMeter workspaces for an account.

projects.list.title: List projects
projects.list.description: List BlazeMeter projects for a workspace.

tests.get.title: Get test
tests.get.description: Get one BlazeMeter performance test by ID.

folders.list.description: List shared folders in a BlazeMeter workspace via GET /folders.
folders.list.title: List shared folders

masters.summary.description: Get request statistics summary for a master test run via GET /masters/{masterId}/reports/default/summary.
masters.summary.title: Get master summary

private-locations.create.description: Create a private location via POST /private-locations. Shared ('small') locations accept one or more functionalities in funcIds; Dedicated ('large') locations accept exactly one.
private-locations.create.title: Create private location

private-locations.list.description: List private locations via GET /private-locations. Supply accountId, workspaceId, or both as filters; types filters by 'small' (Shared) or 'large' (Dedicated).
private-locations.list.title: List private locations

private-locations.servers.create.description: Create an agent for a private location via POST /private-locations/{harborId}/servers. harborId is the private location ID.
private-locations.servers.create.title: Create private location agent

projects.create.description: Create a project in a workspace via POST /projects.
projects.create.title: Create project

projects.get.description: Get one BlazeMeter project by ID via GET /projects/{projectId}.
projects.get.title: Get project

projects.update.description: Partially update a project via PATCH /projects/{projectId}. Only the provided fields change.
projects.update.title: Update project

search.create.description: Run an advanced search over BlazeMeter entities via POST /search with MongoDB-style filters and ordering.
search.create.title: Search entities

search.metadata.description: Download search metadata (entities, fields, relationships, operators) via GET /search/metadata.
search.metadata.title: Get search metadata

tags.create.description: Create a workspace-scoped tag via POST /workspaces/{workspaceId}/tags.
tags.create.title: Create workspace tag

tests.create.description: Create a performance test via POST /tests. configuration requires type, filename, testMode and scriptType; extra configuration keys pass through unchanged.
tests.create.title: Create test

tests.duplicate.description: Duplicate a test with all its configuration via GET /tests/{testId}/duplicate. Returns 201 with the new test.
tests.duplicate.title: Duplicate test

tests.files.delete.description: Delete an uploaded asset file from a test via POST /tests/{testId}/delete-file.
tests.files.delete.title: Delete test file

tests.files.list.description: List files attached to a test via GET /tests/{testId}/files. Download links expire after 20 minutes.
tests.files.list.title: List test files

tests.files.upload.description: Upload a file asset to a test via POST /tests/{testId}/files. The runner sends the file bytes as a raw application/octet-stream request body; BlazeMeter documents this endpoint as multipart/form-data with field file.
tests.files.upload.title: Upload test file

tests.list.description: List performance tests via GET /tests. Supply workspaceId, projectId, or both; sort[] accepts 'name', 'created' or 'updated' with an optional leading '-' for descending order.
tests.list.title: List tests

tests.update.description: Partially update a test via PATCH /tests/{testId}. Only the provided fields change.
tests.update.title: Update test

tests.validate.description: Run file validation for a test via POST /tests/{testId}/validate. Check results with tests.validations.list.
tests.validate.title: Validate test files

tests.validations.list.description: Get file validation results for a test via GET /tests/{testId}/validations.
tests.validations.list.title: List test file validations

user.invites.list.description: List pending invites for the authenticated user via GET /user/invites.
user.invites.list.title: List user invites

user.projects.list.description: List projects belonging to the authenticated user via GET /user/projects.
user.projects.list.title: List user projects

user.register.description: Register a new BlazeMeter user via POST /user/register.
user.register.title: Register user

workspaces.get.description: Get one BlazeMeter workspace by ID via GET /workspaces/{workspaceId}.
workspaces.get.title: Get workspace

workspaces.masters.terminate.description: Terminate all running masters in a workspace via POST /workspaces/{workspaceId}/terminate-masters. Set dryRun to preview the master IDs without terminating them.
workspaces.masters.terminate.title: Terminate workspace masters

workspaces.users.list.description: List users of a workspace via GET /workspaces/{workspaceId}/users with optional role, enabled and text filters.
workspaces.users.list.title: List workspace users

workspaces.users.update.description: Update a workspace user's roles and enabled state via PUT /workspaces/{workspaceId}/users/{userId}. Assign only one role per user.
workspaces.users.update.title: Update workspace user
